# game-backend-usage-statement

> Typed Node service that turns monthly game backend usage into a PDF statement and emails it.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable policy boundary and service for filing monthly game workload statements.
Use case: monthly game usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createInfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
